info.title: AI LMS Backend
info.description:
Backend of an AI-powered LMS: API + Celery worker, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Qdrant
hybrid retrieval (dense + BM25).

Typical flow:
1. `POST /learners` and `POST /videos` (poll `GET /jobs/{id}` until `succeeded`)
2. `POST /videos/{id}/search` or `/ask` to query the video's content
3. `POST /videos/{id}/progress` — crossing the completion threshold generates an assessment
4. `GET /assessments/{id}` → `POST /assessments/{id}/submit`
5. `GET /assessments/{id}/result` and `GET /assessments/{id}/report`

post.summary: Register a video by URL and start processing it
post.description: Returns immediately with a job to poll at `GET /jobs/{id}`.

post.summary: Upload a video, audio or transcript file

delete.summary: Delete a video and everything derived from it
delete.description:
Removes the video, its transcript chunks and search vectors, watch progress, and every
assessment, answer and report made for it. Refused while a job for the video is running.

get.summary: The transcript the pipeline extracted, line by line
get.description:
The raw material everything else is built from: the caption lines, the Whisper output
or the uploaded file, before chunking. Available as soon as the transcribe stage is done.

post.summary: Retrieve the transcript chunks most relevant to a query
Answer a question from the video's content, with citations
Report how much of the video a learner has watched
post.description:
When `percent_watched` reaches the completion threshold, an assessment is generated
automatically (once per learner and video). The response then carries its id.

get.summary: The assessment and its questions (without the answer key)

post.description: Unanswered questions score zero. Poll the returned job, then fetch the result and report.

post.summary: Discard this attempt and generate a new set of questions
post.description:
The answers and report of the current attempt are deleted. The new questions are
written to differ from the previous ones.

get.summary: Per-question score, correctness, feedback and areas of improvement
The learning report for a completed assessment

schema.title: Response Read Report Assessments  Assessment Id  Report Get

get.summary: A learner's watch progress and assessment on each video
get.description:
Videos are shared by all learners. This returns the part that is personal: how much
of each video this learner has watched, and the status and score of their assessment.
Videos the learner has not started are not listed.

schema.title: Response Learner Progress Learners  Learner Id  Progress Get

delete.summary: Delete a learner and everything that belongs to them
delete.description:
Removes the learner with their watch progress, assessments, answers and reports.
Videos are shared, so they stay. Refused while one of the learner's quizzes is being
written or graded.

get.summary: Status and current stage of a background job

post.description:
Retryable failures are retried automatically; this is for jobs that ran out of attempts.
Every job is idempotent, so a retry continues from cached work (e.g. the transcript).
